text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, Feb 3 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - Berth vacant, 3 vessels due by 15/2, no delays.
Dalrymple Bay - Two vessels loading, 3 waiting, 12 due by 19/2, approx. 1-2 days delay expected.
Hay Point - One vessel loading, 1 waiting, 11 due by 15/2, approx. 1 days day expected.
Gladstone - R.G. Tanna - 1 Vessel loading, 15 due by 25/2, no delays.
Barney Point - 1 Vessel loading, 7 due by 26/2, no delays.
Brisbane - Berth vacant, 4 vessels due by 3/3, no delays.

NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Kooragang - 2 Vessels loading, 3 waiting, 19 due by 17/2, approx. 2-3 days delay expected. Channel (dyke) - 2 Vessels loading, 4 waiting, 16 due by 16/2, approx. 3-4 days delay expected. Port Kembla - One vessel loading, 2 waiting, 9 vessels due by 20/2, approx. 1-2 days delay expected.

IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point), A berth - 3 Vessels anchored, 4 due by 8/2. Bberth - 1 Vessel completed, 3 anchored, 4 due by 9/2, 13 others due by 24/2, no eta received.
Goldsworthy (Finucane island) - 1 Vessel loading, 3 due by 8/2, 3 others due by 22/2, no eta received.
Dampier - Parker Point - 4 Vessels due by 6/2.
East Intercourse island - 1 Vessel loading, 1 anchored, 3 due by 8/2.
Dampier line-up - 13 Vessels due by 18/2, of which 8 for Parker Point, 5 for East intercourse island.
East Intercourse island shut down for maintenance 11.00 hrs. 4/2 until 11. 00 hrs. 5/2.
Port Walcott - One vessel loading, 9 due by 32/2.
Feb 5 - GRAIN - QUEENSLAND - Mackay - No vessels due. Grain shipments expected to commence late April assuming sufficient rainfall by end-Feb to plant
Gladstone - No vessels due.
Brisbane - One vessel loading wheat, 2 waiting to load wheat, 1 due 8/2 to load barley.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - One vessel loading barley, 1 durum/wheat. 5 Vessels due by 28/2 of which 3 to load barley, 2 wheat.
Port Kembla - Two vessels waiting to load barley, 2 waiting to load wheat, 9 due by 21/2 of which 7 to load wheat, 1 barley, 1 tba.
VICTORIA - Geelong - One vessel loading wheat, 1 loading barley, 1 waiting to load wheat. 9 Vessels due by 1/3 of which 6 to load wheat, 2 barley, 1 canola.
Portland - One vessel loading wheat, 9 due by 5/3 of which 7 to load wheat, 2 canola.
SOUTH AUSTRALIA - One vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load wheat, 3 due by 12/2 of which 2 to load wheat, 1 barley.
Port Adelaide - One vessel loading beans, 1 loading wheat, 4 waiting to load of which 2 wheat, 1 barley, 1 wheat/barley. 1 Vessel due 6/2 to load wheat.
Thevenard - One vessel loading wheat.
Port Lincoln - Two vessels loading wheat, 12 due by 27/2, all to load wheat.
Wallaroo - Two vessels loading wheat, 3 waiting to load wheat, 4 Vessels due by 13/2, all to load wheat.
Ardrossan - No vessels due.
Port Giles - Four vessels due by 19/2, all to load wheat.
Geraldton - Grain berth closed from 15/1 for 5-6 weeks.
Kwinana - Twelve vessels due by 16/2 of which 2 lupins, 10 wheat.
Albany - One vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load barley. 9 Vessels due by 22/2 of which 7 to load wheat, 1 oats, 1 barley.
Esperance - One vessel loading barley, 1 waiting to load barley, 4 Vessels due by 17/2 of which 2 barley, 2 wheat.
